paragraphs: Octave describes its offering as one platform covering the full lifecycle, from design through operation. The company groups its products into four core capabilities: design, build, operate and protect. Design work covers 3D modeling, engineering analysis and simulation tools, while build work covers supply chain coordination, resource management and construction planning.

Octave states that its customers are companies that design and build large projects, along with owners and operators who keep complex systems running. Reported figures include 14K customers across 180 countries and 7K employees in 45 countries.

The protect capability covers public safety, physical security and cybersecurity technologies for incident response. The site states that 1B+ people worldwide are protected by its public safety solutions.

quote.text: From first design through decades of operation — one platform, one thread of intelligence.
